name: Keep movement steady across a camera cut
body: Movement is relative to the camera, so a cut to a shot from the front would flip the stick. While a shot is active, the movement basis is latched to the yaw the player had when the cut began, and released when the stick returns to neutral. Provisional design, noted for Dean.

comments.text: Done, provisional (D-139): the heading latches while the stick is pushed through a change.

acceptance_criteria: Holding forward through a cut keeps the player walking the same way
Releasing the stick takes the new camera's basis
